displayName: Named transition durations and the night lamps
description: How long each half of the atmosphere takes to travel between two snapshots, and what a lamp at a held building is. Every duration is named so a test and a capture can talk about the same one.

reducedMotion.note: B9's reduced motion, read from user://settings.cfg. Nothing is cut: the same values arrive, in a fifth of the time, and the rain and mist emitters stop moving rather than disappearing.

nightPointLight.note: One warm lamp per held building at night. Placement comes from the board (P4) through Atmosphere.board_anchor_provider; with no board attached the lamps are resolved and reported but nothing is spawned, and the snapshot's building list is still what decides how many there would be.

notes: Durations are wall-clock seconds of tween, not simulation time. Nothing here reads a clock to decide a value: the values come from the snapshot and only their travel takes time.
The heat duration is the longest on purpose -- a sky that changed as fast as the weather would read as weather.
